roadmap.title: Early story and first tools
roadmap.description: Play the opening missions and the first province. Pick up the quick unlocks while you learn the drone, binoculars, pistol and rebel ops.

roadmap.title: Open-world challenges
roadmap.description: With your skills bought, do the explosive, mortar and sniper setups, side mission types, convoys and driving.

roadmap.title: Finish the story and co-op
roadmap.description: Clear every province, then do the two co-op achievements with a partner.

roadmap.title: Collections and upgrades
roadmap.description: Collect documents, legends, medals and weapons, buy every skill and max the rebel skills and level.

roadmap.title: Narco Road
roadmap.description: Play the Narco Road DLC: the cartel bosses, the final target, the vehicle and Electro challenges, then fill every followers gauge.

roadmap.title: Fallen Ghosts
roadmap.description: Play the Fallen Ghosts DLC, the new enemy types and tools, then clear every rebel op.

achievements.summary: Skydive 10 times with the parachute.

steps.text: Buy the parachute skill in the items skill section.
Jump from a helicopter, a plane or a high ledge and open the parachute. Repeat until you have done it 10 times.

achievements.description: Shot an enemy chopper out of the air with a mortar.
achievements.summary: Shoot down an enemy helicopter with a mortar strike.

guide.context: Timing is the hard part. If you call the strike too early, the helicopter never lifts off. If you call it too late, it flies out of range. If you fail, die or leave to the menu and the side mission resets.

steps.text: Finish the main mission Rebellion Rising in Itacua to unlock the @mechanic{Mortar} rebel skill.
Start a Steal the Helicopter side mission. Turn off your AI teammates first, because they may kill the pilot too soon.
Mark or shoot the helicopter, or alert the lieutenant next to it, so he runs to the helicopter to escape.
Aim at the helicopter. As the lieutenant enters it, call the mortar strike from the rebel command wheel.

achievements.summary: Drive cars and bikes for a total of 100 km.

guide.context: Distance from all cars and bikes adds up. Aircraft and boats do not count.

steps.text: Drive cars and bikes until the total reaches 100 km. Driving back and forth on the dried salt lake in @loc{Koani}, in the north-west, is a fast way to add distance.

achievements.summary: Interrogate 20 informants and lieutenants in total.

guide.context: In co-op, you must be the player who does the interrogation.

steps.text: Interrogate informants in main missions and grab lieutenants in the open world. The main missions alone give about 30.

achievements.description: Found 50% of the documents in the game.
achievements.summary: Find half of all documents.

steps.text: Discover named places (bases, outposts, checkpoints and villages) to reveal documents on the map. Pick them up as you play. Legend items are not documents.

achievements.summary: Find every document.

guide.context: The region counters on the map are not always right. A document can sit in the next region near a border. The achievement may also unlock before you have all of them.

steps.text: Fly a helicopter close to each named place so its documents show on the map. Legend items are not documents.
Land close to each document, grab it and take off. Lowest difficulty makes this faster.
Check the map for each region's count. If a document looks missing, check the neighbouring regions.

achievements.summary: Defeat the first boss of the story.

steps.text: Advance the story in Itacua, the first province, until you defeat its boss.

achievements.summary: Finish the story.

steps.text: Clear every province and kill every boss.

achievements.summary: Complete the Smuggling operation.

steps.text: Keep clearing story missions in each province. This unlocks on its own when the operation is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete the Production operation.

steps.text: Keep clearing story missions in each province. This unlocks on its own when the operation is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete the Security operation.

steps.text: Keep clearing story missions in each province. This unlocks on its own when the operation is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete the Influence operation.

steps.text: Keep clearing story missions in each province. This unlocks on its own when the operation is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete every story mission.

guide.context: The world map shows how many missions you have done in each region. Back up your save before the last mission, because this achievement sometimes fails to unlock.

steps.text: Complete the missions in every region. Replay a mission from the map if you are missing one.

achievements.description: Took out a sniper with a pistol.
achievements.summary: Kill a sniper with a pistol.

steps.text: Mark a sniper in a guard tower. Snipers show an orange crosshair icon.
Equip your pistol, go close and kill the sniper. Being spotted does not matter, but a pistol loses damage over distance.

achievements.summary: Complete 3 missions in online co-op with another player.

guide.context: Replayed missions count.

steps.text: Invite a friend or join a public session from the lobby menu.
Complete any 3 missions together.

achievements.summary: Complete the first mission, Amaru's Rescue.

steps.text: Play the first story mission to the end.

achievements.summary: Mark 100 enemies with the drone.

steps.text: Launch the drone before each fight and aim it at enemies to mark them. Enemies respawn at named places, so you can repeat this.

achievements.summary: Mark 100 enemies with the binoculars.

guide.context: Marks made with the drone do not count.

steps.text: Use the binoculars before each fight and aim at enemies to mark them. Enemies respawn at named places, so you can repeat this.

achievements.description: Killed 7 enemies with a single C4 blast.
achievements.summary: Take out 7 enemies with one C4 explosion.

guide.context: You need the C4 skill. Buying Diversion Lure, and Explosion Radius if you have trouble, makes this easier. Finished main missions can be replayed from the map.

steps.text: Buy the C4 and Diversion Lure item skills.

Go to the first objective of the main mission The Deserter in Montuyoc, where 7 enemies stand close together. Another spot is near the Koani Delta rally point in the north-west, where exactly 7 enemies stand together. Mark them with the drone to count them.
Throw a Diversion Lure or fire the flare gun so they bunch up. Then blind them with a flashbang.
Run in, throw the C4 into the middle of the group and detonate it.
If it goes wrong in The Deserter, kill the marked leader or let him get away to restart near the group.

achievements.description: Killed 7 enemies with a single mine.
achievements.summary: Take out 7 enemies with one mine explosion.

guide.context: You need the Mine skill. The mine blast is smaller than the C4 blast, so enemies must stand very close. Explosion Radius makes it easier.

steps.text: Buy the Mine and Diversion Lure item skills.

Go to the first objective of the main mission The Deserter in Montuyoc, where 7 enemies stand close together. Another spot is near the Koani Delta rally point in the north-west. Mark the group with the drone.
Throw a Diversion Lure or fire the flare gun so they bunch up, then blind them with one or two flashbangs.
Place the mine among them, back away and shoot the mine.

achievements.summary: Find one Legend item.

steps.text: Discover a named place (base, outpost, checkpoint or village) and pick up an item named LEGEND, shown with its own map icon.

achievements.summary: Find every Legend item.

guide.context: Legends are not documents. All of them are at named places and none can be missed.

steps.text: Fly close to each named place so its Legend items appear on the map.
Pick up every item named LEGEND.

achievements.description: Played each type of side mission.
achievements.summary: Finish a side mission from every category.

steps.text: Read intel files and choose the option that reveals side missions. They show as green icons on the map.

Do all eight kinds: stealing a helicopter, stealing a plane, tagging drop site supplies, grabbing and intimidating a sicario, stopping a convoy, blowing up a station entrance, deactivating an antenna and starting a radio.

achievements.summary: Tag 10 convoys.

guide.context: Convoys respawn when you die, so you can repeat the same one.

steps.text: Start a Stop the Convoy side mission and stop the convoy by shooting it or using the EMP drone.
Once it has stopped, go behind it and tag it for the rebels. Repeat until you have tagged 10.

achievements.description: Bought all the upgrades of a Skill branch.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade in one skill branch.

steps.text: Earn skill points from level-ups, bosses and skill point pickups, and resources from side missions.
Choose one branch (Weapon, Drone, Item, Physical or Squad) and buy all its upgrades.

achievements.summary: Buy every skill upgrade in the game.

guide.context: This is a long grind. You do not need every skill point on the map.

steps.text: Skill points come from level-ups, bosses (3-10 each), skill point pickups (6-8 per region) and clearing high-level regions.
Resources come mostly from side missions. Convoy side missions worth 5000 or more are the fastest.
For a convoy, call an armed helicopter and destroy the escorts. Damage the main truck until it stops, then tag it.

achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade in the Drone skill branch.

steps.text: Open the skills menu and buy every skill in the Drone branch.

achievements.summary: Collect every bonus medal.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals collectibles. Medals show as blue icons.
Collect every medal.

achievements.summary: Unlock one Rebel skill.

steps.text: Complete one rebel ops side mission.

achievements.summary: Unlock all five Rebel skills.

guide.context: The five are Spotting, Diversion, Mortar, Guns for Hire and Vehicle Drop-Off.

steps.text: Complete one rebel ops mission of each type. The quest icon on the map shows which skill it gives.

achievements.summary: Raise every Rebel skill to its maximum level.

guide.context: Each skill has 3 strength levels and several cooldown levels. Do not play every rebel op blindly.

steps.text: Open the Rebel Support page in the skills menu and see which skills are not maxed.
Do only the rebel ops that reward those skills, until all five are maxed.

achievements.summary: Collect every shotgun model.

guide.context: Weapons are open-world pickups revealed by intel, plus drops from bosses. The weapon list also shows DLC weapons, which you do not need.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals weapons. They show as blue icons with a plus sign.
Pick up every shotgun from the open world and kill the bosses to get their drops.

achievements.summary: Collect every handgun model.

guide.context: Weapons are open-world pickups revealed by intel, plus drops from bosses. The weapon list also shows DLC weapons, which you do not need.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals weapons. They show as blue icons with a plus sign.
Pick up every handgun from the open world and kill the bosses to get their drops.

achievements.description: Maxed out your XP and levels.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level, level 30.

steps.text: Earn XP by killing enemies and completing missions. Main missions give the most and can be replayed from the map.

achievements.description: Hit a target more than 400m away.
achievements.summary: Hit a target more than 400 m away.

steps.text: Get a sniper rifle. One is in the weapon case at the Itacua Echo rally point in northern Itacua.
Go to the enemy checkpoint north of the rally point. Walk along the road or hill until you are 400 m from a guard tower.
Mark an enemy with the binoculars to see the distance, aim above the target for bullet drop and fire.

achievements.description: Made a close-combat kill at night.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy in melee at night.

steps.text: Wait for night, sneak into an enemy base and attack an enemy from behind with a melee takedown. A sleeping enemy in the living quarters is easy to reach.

achievements.description: Killed an enemy in close combat who was hurt by another player.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy in melee after another player has hurt it.

guide.context: Online co-op only. The enemy must stay alive after the shot.

steps.text: Play in a co-op session. Pick one enemy, preferably an armored Unidad soldier.
Ask your partner to shoot the enemy once without killing it.
Run up and kill the enemy with a melee takedown.

achievements.description: Killed an enemy with a drone.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a drone.

steps.text: Buy the explosive drone in the Drone skill tree. A higher level may be needed.
Equip it, fly it into an enemy and detonate it.

achievements.description: Destroyed a generator with a C4 blast.
achievements.summary: Blow up an enemy generator with C4.

steps.text: Buy the C4 item skill.
Find the generator in a larger enemy base, throw C4 on it and detonate it.

achievements.summary: Collect every submachine-gun model.

guide.context: Weapons are open-world pickups revealed by intel, plus drops from bosses. The weapon list also shows DLC weapons, which you do not need.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals weapons. They show as blue icons with a plus sign.
Pick up every submachine-gun from the open world and kill the bosses to get their drops.

achievements.summary: Collect every light machine-gun model.

guide.context: Weapons are open-world pickups revealed by intel, plus drops from bosses. The weapon list also shows DLC weapons, which you do not need.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals weapons. They show as blue icons with a plus sign.
Pick up every light machine-gun from the open world and kill the bosses to get their drops.

achievements.summary: Collect every sniper rifle model.

guide.context: Weapons are open-world pickups revealed by intel, plus drops from bosses. The weapon list also shows DLC weapons, which you do not need.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals weapons. They show as blue icons with a plus sign.
Pick up every sniper rifle from the open world and kill the bosses to get their drops.

achievements.summary: Collect every assault rifle model.

guide.context: Weapons are open-world pickups revealed by intel, plus drops from bosses. The weapon list also shows DLC weapons, which you do not need.

steps.text: Read intel at named places and choose the option that reveals weapons. They show as blue icons with a plus sign.
Pick up every assault rifle from the open world and kill the bosses to get their drops.

achievements.description: Operation Narco Road: Kill One boss of the cartel
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, kill one of the cartel bosses.

guide.context: If it does not unlock after a boss kill, start a new save and kill Eddie there.

steps.text: Play the Narco Road main missions until you kill one cartel boss.

achievements.description: Operation Narco Road: Kill the final target
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, kill the final target.

steps.text: Finish the last main mission, The Last Laugh. At the end, take the PDA, escape through the tunnel by vehicle and shoot down the helicopter that takes off. A heavy sniper rifle helps.
Skip the cutscenes and credits so the achievement can unlock.

achievements.description: Operation Narco Road: Fill the Followers Gauge of all regions to 100%
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, fill the Followers gauge to 100% in every region.

guide.context: There are 4 regions and each needs 3500 followers. The content gives exactly that amount, so you must finish all of it. Plan about 2 hours per region. If it does not unlock right away, wait or resync your save.

steps.text: In each region, complete all main missions.
Finish every green side mission: Lost Cars, Airspray, Amphetatruck and Animal Traffic.
Finish every Electro challenge. They come as drifts, climbs, aerobatics, bike trials and jumps.
Spawn vehicles and helicopters or fast travel to save time.

achievements.description: Narco Road: Go from Eddie's party villa to Arturo's bar in 8 minutes or less in a ground vehicle
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, reach Arturo's bar from Eddie's party villa within 8 minutes, driving a ground vehicle.

guide.context: The timer starts when you leave the villa area.

steps.text: Fast travel to Eddie's Big Villa in the north-east and take the sports car at the entrance. Set a marker on Arturo's Bar near Laguna Colorada in the south-west.
Follow the GPS route and use your boost. Avoid monster trucks, which are unstable. About 6 minutes is enough.

achievements.description: Operation Narco Road: Kill 50 enemies with any gang's vehicle
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, use a gang vehicle to kill 50 enemies.

guide.context: The gang helicopter does not count.

steps.text: Call in a monster truck or take a gang vehicle.
Drive to the Unidad base F.O.B. Buitre near Media Luna Alpha and run over enemies. More enemies arrive as your wanted level rises.

achievements.description: Operation Narco Road: Complete an Electro™ challenge while freefalling
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, finish an Electro challenge during a freefall.

guide.context: You need at least 150 m of height to get a parachute. The achievement unlocks as soon as you pass through the ring, even if you die after.

steps.text: Fast travel to Eddie's Campsite and find the aerobatic challenge, a blue ring, near it on the map.
Take a helicopter and fly high, a couple of hundred metres past the ring.
Jump out and turn toward the ring. Fall through it. A parachute glide also works.

achievements.description: Operation Narco Road: Complete a trial without using the brakes
achievements.summary: In Narco Road, finish a trial without touching the brakes.

steps.text: Do a bike trial slowly, without braking or reversing. The quarry trial and the one near Icoya in the south-east are easy.

achievements.description: Fallen Ghosts: Kill one of each Extranjeros squad archetypes
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, kill one enemy of each Extranjeros squad type.

guide.context: The four types are Armored, Covert Ops, Elite Sniper and Jammer. Tag kills do not count, so make the kill yourself.

steps.text: Armored: shoot in the head, or use a sync shot. Armored enemies are found at F.O.B. Tucan in the Eastern Precinct.
Covert Ops: switch to thermal vision to see and mark them, then kill one. They are also at F.O.B. Tucan.
Elite Sniper and Jammer: find an outpost in the Western Precinct and kill one of each. The Jammer disables drones, electronics and your minimap.

achievements.displayName: A hero once, a hero twice
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, complete the operation.

guide.context: If it does not unlock, replay the final mission.

steps.text: Complete all the main missions, ending with the final leader in the first province.

achievements.description: Fallen Ghosts: Complete every Rebel Op and Mission
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, finish all Rebel Ops and all missions.

guide.context: Some ops do not appear until you finish ops in another region. Sync your save before the last mission and keep a Headhunter op for last, in case the achievement fails to unlock.

steps.text: Complete all four Rebel Op types: Sabotage, Rebel VIP, Headhunter and Towers, plus all main missions.
Tower: begin the broadcast, lie flat at the top of the stairs and sit through the 3-4 minute countdown.
VIP: after you talk to the VIP, enemies spawn. Kill the rocket helicopter first, then hide the VIP in a corner while you clear the rest.
Finish the final ops that appear after you clear the others of each type.

achievements.description: Fallen Ghosts: Complete a Final Rebel Op
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, complete one Final Rebel Op.

steps.text: Complete every Rebel Op of one type (Sabotage, Rebel VIP, Headhunter or Towers) so its final op appears. Do the regions that have only one op of that type first.
Finish the final op of that type.

achievements.description: Fallen Ghosts: Blind yourself using the Flash Drone
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, use the Flash Drone to blind yourself.

steps.text: Complete the first Fallen Ghosts mission to open the Fallen Ghosts tab in the skills menu. Then spend 1 skill point and about 500 resources on tier one of the Flash Drone.
Equip the Flash Drone, fly it right in front of you, look at it and flash it.

achievements.description: Fallen Ghosts: Kill 10 Covert Ops Extranjeros using your knife
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, melee-kill 10 Covert Ops Extranjeros.

guide.context: Any melee attack counts, even if your character does not use the knife.

steps.text: Switch to thermal vision (press the vision button twice) and mark the Covert Ops enemies, then take the goggles off.
Sneak up behind each one and melee them. The mission Ghosts in the Western Precinct has over 20 spread out. Replaying the mission Cruzar after the story is another spot, with 3-4 right at the start.

achievements.description: Fallen Ghosts: Destroy an enemy helicopter using an explosive bolt.
achievements.summary: In Fallen Ghosts, bring down an enemy helicopter using an explosive crossbow bolt.

steps.text: Buy the explosive bolt skill and equip the Phobos Crossbow. Switch to the explosive bolts.
Raise your wanted level during the mission Ghosts, or start a Tower rebel op, until an enemy helicopter arrives. Shoot it with an explosive bolt.
